enade-2021-cc-b-d03.notes: CONFIRMED STRUCTURAL FAILURE. Page 14's propositional-logic connective symbols (implication/conjunction/disjunction/negation) were extracted as wrong Latin characters (registered-trademark sign, U-grave, U-acute, O-slash) because their PDF font ('EuclidSymbol-BoldItalic') has no working ToUnicode mapping for those glyphs. Fixed via a new, visually-confirmed, evidence-based font-character substitution (symbol_fonts.py) - all six formulas and the connective definitions now render correctly (->, ^, v, not). HOWEVER: the truth-table (6 formula columns x 4 rows of F/V values, with numeric column headers) has no vector-drawn grid lines for detect_visual_regions to pick up, and its cell-by-cell text layout collapses into an unreadable flat string when read in raster order ('a -> not b b ^ a ... F F V F V F ...'). D3 has zero preserved assets, so unlike D5 there is no visual fallback either - the table content is neither correctly represented as text nor as an image. This directly affects a reader's ability to answer items (a)-(d), all of which reference the table. A safe fix requires a genuine table/grid reconstruction capability not built in Phase 1B. Recommendation: keep needs_review (currently NOT flagged by automatic checks, since they don't detect table-shaped content - this question needs a warning added), visual_validation=failed, and treat as a second primary open structural issue alongside D5.

enade-2021-cc-b-d05.notes: CONFIRMED STRUCTURAL FAILURE (PROMPT Phase 1B section 8/27). D5's page (17) is a genuine two-column layout: left column is prose + a heap-array table image + a binary-tree diagram image + more prose + citation; right column is the complete C-style heapify/buildHeap pseudocode. The rendered statement text is severely broken: it starts mid-sentence ('máximo especifica que...'), is missing the entire opening paragraph, the array table, the tree diagram, and - critically - almost the entire heapify() function body (only fragments of buildHeap survive, interleaved with a misplaced citation fragment and a stray unmatched '}'). This makes the rendered text statement actively misleading for a reader trying to answer item (b), which is specifically about heapify's complexity. HOWEVER: the question's single visual-fidelity asset (figure-01.png) independently captures BOTH columns in full - the complete prose, table, diagram, AND the complete, correctly-indented heapify/buildHeap code - so no information is actually lost to a reader who views the image. Root cause is the two-column layout algorithm (layout.py) not correctly interleaving code-column content with left-column content for this specific figure-heavy, code-heavy page; a general, safe fix requires reworking two-column+code layout reconstruction, which was not attempted in Phase 1B given the risk of an untested change to a core layout algorithm. This question is NOT promoted to verified. Recommendation: keep needs_review, keep automatic_validation=failed, and treat this as a primary open structural issue blocking a full READY_FOR_2011 classification (see final report).
